necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptomatic complaints of giddiness to guide further management. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial under code CO-22.
